The '''preparation place''' (or '''autopsy table''') is where you prepare [[corpse]]s or [[zombie]]s by removing/adding body parts from/to them. Corpses stored in the tier 1 preparation place will have their decay slowed but not stopped, while their decay will be stopped when stored in the tier 2 preparation place.

The [[morgue]] starts with one tier 1 table, but additional constructs may be built after the [[morgue#Workbench|mortuary desk]] is repaired.

Each autopsy table increases the {{Morgue Capacity}} by one. See [[corpse]]s, [[zombie]]s and [[morgue]] for more information about the various mechanics related to the preparation of corpses.

==Surgeon's Mistake==
{| class="wikitable"
!Icon
!Label
!Description
!Notes
|-
|[[File:SurgeonMistake.png|52px|Surgeon's Mistake]]
|Surgeon's Mistake
|Your inexperience shows. - The surgery didn't go very well. You've made a mess of the body, lowering it's quality.
|Surgeon's mistakes occur randomly while removing a body part. It shows as a "body part" (see icon) that cannot be removed. The surgeon's mistake removes one {{Skull|White}} and adds one {{Skull|Red}}. To reduce the odds of this occurring, the player may take various precautions, such as unlocking the [[Perks|butcher perk]] and the [[Perks|surgeon perk]] and upgrading Preparation place to II 
|}
